items.title: Plague panic after a death at a Russian plague lab
items.summary: A Siberian plague-lab technician died of pneumonia after reportedly breaking a tube of plague bacteria, and US feeds filled with lab-escape claims. Russian officials denied any accident, and her contacts tested negative.
items.author: @visegrad24

post.name: Visegrád 24
post.text:
BREAKING:

5 hospitals have been closed for quarantines in Siberia due to a possible plague outbreak.
